decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet builds on the firm's core carpet design knowledge and still has its own page in 2024, so management can read its results and refine it within existing capabilities.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws on established craft and material expertise in premium rugs, and its continued presence shows the firm can assimilate the market feedback and keep it as part of the core range.

The corner bench is further from the firm's carpet-based knowledge and dropped from a page of its own to a mention in 2024, but it was still promoted as a new interpretation, so management keeps it for now while it learns from its results.

This low-pile carpet sits close to existing know-how, but a sibling low-pile product (C) was already removed, which suggests some pruning within this overlapping line; its own page remaining in 2024 supports keeping it.

The swivel shell chair relies on furniture design and engineering knowledge that is less central than carpets, yet its stable own-page presence over two years indicates it is being absorbed into the portfolio.
